rows.text: This is your third day after being promoted! For some reason, you have become the owner of all the space in the entire high-rise!
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: You pin a self-made level P-35 badge on your chest, thinking it's time you show off your accomplishments to everyone!
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: You look at the emptiness all around you.
You wield unlimited power! But your hands remain empty. Lose all Cosmic Fragments and enhance all Blessings.
Directly provoke P-48 Madam Scarred Eye!

None of the big shots responds to you! Suddenly, you come to terms with reality... You take a puff of cigarette while staring at empty space, then walk back along the deserted street... At last, you lean on a cement pillar, looking low-spirited and crestfallen.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: Indeed... this is not the outcome you have expected. What did you do to make things so wrong? You wish you could start everything over. Perhaps, you would have chosen a different path in the beginning.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: ...You slowly lose consciousness. As it turns out, all employees consumed by greed are subject to a mysterious treatment that will turn them into portraits on the walls of the IPC's secret conference room.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe
